provider_protocols.name: OpenAI Responses-compatible protocol subset
tested_environments: opt-in macOS 26.2 arm64 live OpenAI observations on 2026-08-19 and deprecated experimental context compaction on 2026-08-20
limitations: The blocking release gate remains a local fake; the content-free artifacts record opt-in live connectivity, one fixed synthetic-secret redaction path, one deprecated experimental context-compaction path, and pinned Codex observations, not complete DLP, a provider SLA, retention, residency, availability, or every-model claim.
Context-specific compaction evidence is retained as historical compatibility evidence under ADR 0008 and is not a supported product or release criterion.
Compaction coverage is limited to direct current-user input plus required-mode denial without it; no authorized continuation-binding observation exists.

provider_protocols.name: Anthropic Messages-compatible protocol subset
limitations: No live Anthropic endpoint conformance or provider-SLA evidence is included; token-count coverage is protocol-shaped local evidence only.
Model discovery is a policy-filtered Hormuz client endpoint and does not call Anthropic.

provider_protocols.name: Live OpenAI and Anthropic production conformance
limitations: Repository CI uses no live provider credential. One opt-in OpenAI observation does not prove combined OpenAI and Anthropic behavior, quota, retention, residency, or availability commitments.

persistence.name: PostgreSQL accounting, identity, policy, session, approval, and tenancy foundation
tested_environments: digest-pinned disposable PostgreSQL 16.14 on local Docker and blocking Linux CI
interfaces: shared-schema PostgreSQL with forced row-level security
usage, cost evidence, usage-read audit, and atomic budget reservations
configuration-seeded identity projection and multi-instance human sessions
secret-free policy projection, one-time DLP approvals, and security evidence
limitations: ADR 0002 is accepted and schema version 4 can persist live usage, cost evidence, usage-read audit, shared budget reservations, configuration-seeded identities and policies, authorization versions, human sessions, DLP approvals, and security evidence. The deprecated context experiment is excluded from this persistence plan; SCIM, cutover backfill, coordinated policy rollout, pooling, backup, restore, deletion, KMS, HA, and production-persistence proof remain open.
